name: Deliveries
why: A bakery's deliveries counted per time bin and route over the whole log, so each morning's rounds and a late one stand out; a bar lists its deliveries.
data: deliveries.jsonl: one line per delivery, the drop-off at one stop of a van's round, with `at` (when the van reached the stop, ISO 8601), `route` (the van's round: north, river or old town), `stop` (the customer), `order` (what was dropped off), `status` (delivered, left at door, late or refused) and, on some, `note`. Deliveries relate only through time and route; the lines are not in time order.

accepts.means: the delivery on line <n>, listed in its bar

declares.means: one bar's deliveries, written as the bar's start: YYYY-MM-DD for bars of a day or longer, else YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM
